scope: One hundred fifty reviewed tune identities covering one hundred eighty-six EG entries and one hundred ninety-three EG-to-tune relations, primarily nationwide OGTL hymns, and ninety-eight verified public-domain organ works
policy: Manual review only; title similarity is never sufficient on its own; disputed attributions are excluded.
